structural_change: NATIVE-FIX3/gl4 (10-18, placement only, 0 cycles, RTL byte-identical to the closed 30d12242b view): NATIVE-3 audit FAIL launch rn_o[122] 236.3 / rn_o[123] 202.6 / fault 224.1, capture rn_i[215] 197.8 at R 295.7. Measured in the closed route: the rn_* pin flops sat beside their N pins, but their single-fanout chain cells (QN inverter, port buffer, GPL repair buffers) were left 76-151 um away along the FIRM pin-flop band (rn_o[122]: flop 158.9 -> INV 40.8 -> port BUF 85 -> pin 158.7; rn_i[215]: pin 140.5 -> port BUF 287 -> flop 142), and the sticky fault flop (QN also read by its own enable logic, so io_flop_at_pins could not anchor it) sat at x 270 for an S pin at x 110. Fix: pin_reg_split (the fault pin gets a cloned launch flop, same D / clock / reset, anchored at its pin) + pre_dpl_extra chain_pull.tcl (every pin -> pin-flop chain cell further than 6 um from its pin -> flop segment is placed on it before DPL; trial on the closed route's 3_4 db: 26 cells on 2,673 ports moved, DPL max displacement 2.2 um). S81U-GUNIT6 (10-17): native pin rules -- cw captured once (feedthrough stage 1 = eps-table input flops); launch output flop has a kept internal twin feeding launch_s (0 edges). S81U-GUNIT4 (10-17): rst_n via ot_rst_relay (4 kept regions; GUNIT3 gate: port 688 reset loads) and outline 345.6 x 64.8 (GUNIT3 gate: std 9,773 um2 at util 35% in 345.6 x 86.4; the stack width is fixed, the height shortens the rung hops). S81U-GUNIT3 (10-17): dsdv_gunit_l4 successor: the r chain (divc, + eps, rsqrt: 9.9k flops) moved to the E-side leaf dsdv_gunit_l4r (GUNIT2 L4: 21,174 sinks, TT insertion 436 ps, clock-rule FAIL). L4 keeps the golden tree above the slice roots, the 24 mixes, the tail launch and the passes. Outline from the gate's std area (L4 was 22% util at 345.6 x 259.2). Pins at 4 tracks, clock on the free W face. The 24 mixes leave one a cycle (38 pins, -768 flops) instead of a 768-bit register + bus.
